correct_option.description: Index of the right option. Sent only when the answer was right, or after the second wrong answer to this question.

why.description: The explanation for the option that was chosen

wrong_so_far.description: Wrong answers so far to this question

rel_volume.description: volume divided by the mean volume of the first visible days

initial_visible.description: days you can see at the start

seed.description: optional: the same seed rebuilds the same episode

caveats.description: Always shown: survivorship bias, one vendor, licence, not advice

min_sessions_for_long_history.description: A symbol counts as long history with at least this many sessions

created.description: Only in the reply to a new decision: false when the same key was already stored

days_marked.description: Days of results marked so far

result.description: Fractional result after cost; null while pending

client_key.description: The same key twice stores one decision (a double click is safe)

cost_bps.description: Cost of changing stance in basis points, 0 to 50

reason.description: 1 to 280 characters, written before the result is known
reason.example: The price has stayed above its average.

stance.description: long = hold from the close of today; flat = hold nothing. A practice stance, not advice.

present only when you asked for a specific kind, or after the reveal

values.description: Warm-up days have no value and are left out

fraction_as_good.description: share of mixed-up histories that did as well or better

max_drawdown.description: largest fall from a peak, negative

counted.description: false when the same rule and cost had already been run: it is recomputed, not counted again

answered_right.description: Has this learner answered it rightly at least once?

attempts.description: How many times this learner has answered it

visual.description: A diagram or worked calculation shown with the step

python.description: Absent when the Python service could not be asked

created.description: false when this exact guess already existed

outcome.description: 1 if the price went up, 0 if not; null until answered

by_kind.description: revealed episodes only: keys real and synthetic

run.description: Has a quality run been stored at all?

brier.description: Brier score; lower is better; 0.25 is a coin flip

steps_read.description: Steps read so far in this lesson

confirm.description: must be true: opening the vault cannot be undone

rule.description: the same rule on the practice years
